What is the ratio of the number of donuts sold by stores P and R together in October to the total number of donuts sold by stores Q and R together in the same month?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Total number of donuts sold by stores P and R together in October = 125 + 960

⇒ 1085

Total number of donuts sold by stores R and Q together in October = 905 + 960

⇒ 1865

Ratio = 1085 : 1865

⇒ 217 : 373

**∴ The required answer is 217 : 373.**
